Santa.style: Papá Noel on holiday in Montevideo, at the beach on a summer afternoon, in flip-flops: a big, jolly old man with a deep, slightly gravelly, warm voice. Quick comic timing. Clear, well-articulated words. First line: happy and relaxed, setting up a chess game on his towel. Second line: a shout of alarm, a seagull just stole his king. Third line: triumphant and cheeky, to the seagull.

Mago.style: El Mago, a kind, older wizard from Montevideo with a warm voice and a playful smile, at the beach with his friend. First line: calm and practical, a little amused, showing a clever object; say every word clearly, especially 'pliega' and 'piezas' (pi-E-zas, the chess pieces). Last line: warm and inviting, straight to the viewer.
lines: Por eso, el de viaje: se pliega en un tubo de veinticuatro centímetros, y las piezas van adentro.
¿Te vas de vacaciones? Comentá viaje y te paso precio y fecha.

_note: Santa's take added 'Uff,' before s1 and a laugh after it: s1 re-cut to end before the laugh (the subtitle keeps the 'Uff'). El Mago's first take said 'pinzas' for 'piezas' (two transcriptions): re-recorded with 'y las piezas van adentro'; the split then put the start of m2 in m1 and the take repeated m2 at the end: m1 and m2 re-cut by hand (take seconds), the first m2 kept (the shorter one); m1's pause after 'el de viaje' 0.47 -> 0.25 s (raw-clip seconds).
